name: Zupda Vijlikaran Yojana
benefit: - Free electricity household connection is provided to BPL/Lower income group beneficiary.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) or low-income family. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.
